Types

DocSnapshotOnDisk = tuple[version: uint32, checkpointLsn: uint64,

KvSnapshotOnDisk = tuple[version: uint32, checkpointLsn: uint64,

RdbmsSnapshotOnDisk = tuple[version: uint32, checkpointLsn: uint64, tables: seq[tuple[

VectorSnapshotOnDisk = tuple[version: uint32, checkpointLsn: uint64, collections: seq[tuple[
